requirement.description: The parse_obj function incorrectly handles reference objects (like 6 0 R) in dictionaries and arrays. It's returning the raw values instead of converting them to complex numbers (e.g., 6j) as expected by the tests.
requirement.contract: When parsing PDF objects that contain references (e.g., 6 0 R), the parse_obj function should convert these to complex numbers (e.g., 6j) in both dictionary and array contexts. The function should correctly identify the pattern of integer 0 R and convert it to a complex number representation.

requirement.description: The next_token function fails to correctly identify incomplete tokens at the end of input, particularly for values and names. This leads to incorrect tokenization and parsing failures.
requirement.contract: The next_token function should properly detect and return incomplete tokens at the end of input with appropriate token types (e.g., INTEGER, REAL, NAME) instead of returning None or incorrect types.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function doesn't properly handle string parsing with escape sequences, causing failures in text processing tests.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function should correctly parse text strings (both literal and hexadecimal) with proper escape sequence handling, returning the correct decoded strings as expected by the tests.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function fails to properly process comments within arrays and dictionaries, leading to incorrect parsing of elements that follow comments.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function should correctly skip over comments and continue parsing subsequent elements in arrays and dictionaries as expected by the tests.

requirement.description: The next_token function has issues with handling streams, particularly when they are incomplete or at the end of input.
requirement.contract: The next_token function should correctly identify and return stream tokens, even when they are incomplete or at the end of input, with proper handling of the endstream marker.
